messages.subject: Features request
parts:
Features for rattle:

1. use "arules" for Market Basket Analysis
2. add missing values imputations throught:
a. Knn with mean/median
b. use package "mix" with EM/MCMC on mixed values

References
- Rubin
- Schaffer

Take a look at "mix" online help and references for better infos.

Thanks for the suggestions.

Rattle currently uses "arules" under the Unsupervised paragdigm within
the Associations tab. I'll add an option (or even probably just
automatically identify the situtation) to treat a signle identified
input column as a "item" column and use the "ident" column as the basket
identifier, to then do the traditional basket analysis. That should be
easy and will be in next version!

Thanks for the pointer to "mix" and suggestion of knn.

The "mix" package does look interesting. Have you used "mix"? It makes
it a lot easier for me to include the functionality in Rattle if you can
give me some examples of using it (e.g., R code) and guide as to what
choices need to be made and so on. Saves me trying to figure that out
from the documentation (multiplied across a lot of different R packages,
and you get a lot of time spent figuring out the best way to go, so any
help is appreciated).

I am keen to see if I can get some decent imputation into Rattle, and
mix looks good. An alternative seems to be amelia. Any comments on these?

Regards,
Graham

This has been implemented in version 2.1.109. Selecting the
"Unsupervised" paradigm will show the "Associate" tab. Click the
"Baskets" check button to treat the loaded dataset (with the
appropriately identified ID columns) as transactions of the
traditional ID,Item form.
